events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt Street, New York, NY 10007

subway.station: Cortlandt St / WTC Cortlandt / Fulton St

events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week runway experience on Century 21's main floor where anyone can walk the runway and be filmed for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: No ticket or invitation is required. Each walker can receive a free Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches pressed on site, and a $21-off-$100 in-store card, while supplies last.
events.caveats: The official Century 21 page says there is no registration, ticket or invitation. Totes and patches are while supplies last. Walking the runway means being filmed for Century 21 social stories; visitors who do not want to be filmed can watch instead.
events.practical_notes: September 15 and 16 from 12–6 PM on the main floor, Dey Street side. Arriving near noon gives the best chance of receiving the advertised tote and patch selection.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW-branded truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product discovery, sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Current NYC event listings advertise free public access, Dewy Lip Shine product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments. Exact sample or treat quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Two current NYC event sources independently list the same date, time, address and public-access status. No organizer approval or advance RSVP requirement is published. Samples and treats can run out.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. This record relies on corroborated secondary event sources because an official eos event page was not located in this pass.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort Street, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day oversized-vanity beauty activation at Gansevoort Plaza tied to Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free public access, beauty touch-ups, interactive photo moments and free full-size Mary Kay makeup and skincare products while supplies last.
events.caveats: Multiple current event sources agree that the activation is free and open to the public. Promotional product quantities are finite, so free full-size products are while supplies last. No approval-required process is established.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Secondary sources mention RSVP promotion, but they also explicitly describe the experience as open to the public; no approval gate was found.
